findings.description: At 00:00, the grey wall with the vertical framed picture terminates immediately to its right at an inside corner with wooden upper cabinets, a tile backsplash, and a counter holding a microwave. As the camera moves forward between 00:01 and 00:03, that cabinet and counter corner disappears from beside the picture, replaced by an extension of the grey wall (with a small horizontal picture and light switch) and a doorway leading into a bedroom.

The woman turns 90 degrees right from the kitchen at 00:03 to enter the bedroom, facing the bed on the far wall. At 00:06-00:07, she turns 90 degrees left (rather than turning 180 degrees back toward the doorway she entered) and walks through a doorway on the perpendicular wall that impossibly connects straight back into the kitchen along her original direction of travel. Additionally, the vertical framed picture that was on the kitchen wall at 00:00-00:03 is now hanging inside the bedroom to the left of this doorway at 00:07.

When the woman exits the bedroom back into the kitchen at 00:08-00:09, the kitchen's fixed layout has changed compared to 00:00-00:02: a stainless steel microwave is now mounted under the cabinets above the stove on the left, the right side of the hallway opening now has a small framed picture and a window curtain, and the far white door now has exposed glass panes instead of sheer curtains.
